notes: weights + activations are real: local GR00T-N1.7-3B safetensors (global_step global_step196000), BEHAVIOR 2026-challenge-demos frame (same episode/frame as the k005b export)
backbone config/processor: local Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct (same architecture, shapes match exactly); weights are GR00T's own backbone.* tensors; the LM is truncated to select_layer=16 layers
deepstack: vision blocks 5/11/17 are added to the image rows after LM layers 0/1/2 (outside the layer); L0..L2 mlp_resid is the layer output before that add
embodiment slot 23 (sim_behavior_r1_pro) is untrained (per-slot std = init 0.02): the state/action encoders and the action decoder are real-but-untrained weights; the decoded actions carry no meaning
state = BEHAVIOR 61-dim proprio (q01/q99 -> [-1,1]) in slots 0..60 of 132; actions: dims 0..22 of 132 shown
only head 0 of the 32 vl_self_attention / DiT heads is exported; to_out / ff biases are folded into the outputs
compute in float32 from bf16 weights (official runtime: bf16); asserts vs transformers and the official Isaac-GR00T AlternateVLDiT / SelfAttentionTransformer
noise seed 0; Euler integrates upward t = 0, .25, .5, .75 (t=0 is noise), x += v/4
